uiFont.tooltip: Bundle name in the assets/ folder used for general UI (menus, HUD, computers, dialog, ship UI, signalscope). Both the bundle file and the font asset inside must share this name (e.g. assets/ui_font and ui_font.ttf inside the bundle).

shipUiFont.tooltip: Optional override for the ship cockpit console (Flashlight ON, Autopilot aborted) and the signalscope on-screen labels. Leave empty to fall back to the UI font.

dialogFont.tooltip: Optional override for character dialog boxes (name field, main text, dialog option list). Leave empty to fall back to the UI font.

nomaiFont.tooltip: Bundle used for the Nomai translator prop. Leave empty to fall back to the UI font.
